title: Liquid Container
note: A COMPONENT schema, added to an individual asset (the asset popup's Add schema button) and stored as its own top-level 'liquid_container' block. The asset holds ONE kind of liquid (an asset of the liquids category) at a time, up to capacity_l liters; the liquid weighs liters x its weight_kg per liter. Buckets, jugs, jerry cans, drums, barrels and tanks use it. It is separate from the 'container' component, which holds solid items by weight. A container can come full: filled_with and filled_l say what is in it when it is bought. Containers do not stack in the toolbar (adding the schema sets properties.max_stack_size to 1).

capacity_l.label: Capacity (L)
capacity_l.note: The most liters this container holds.

accepts.label: Accepts
accepts.note: Which liquids it takes: tags (#liquid_fuel, #liquid_dairy, #liquid_oil, #liquid) and/or exact liquid assets, chosen with the asset picker. Empty = any liquid.

filled_with.label: Comes Filled With
filled_with.note: A container that is SOLD FULL (a jug of drinking water, a can of fuel): the liquid asset it holds when bought (liquid_water, liquid_gasoline ...). Leave empty for a container that is sold empty. Must be a liquid the container accepts.

filled_l.label: Filled Liters
filled_l.note: How many liters of filled_with it holds when bought (its capacity for a full one). 0 or empty with filled_with set means full.
